study.question: Does native action-codebook learning restore a full-versus-action-blind click-AUC advantage at action-RMS membership initialization, or does the sign reversal persist? This is a missing interaction contrast in the conditional historical-action utility question, not a new architecture or a tuning claim.
study.hypothesis: Observed limitation: native/zero full minus blind AUC is 0.0009886416993761; frozen/zero is 0.0008599544305762; frozen/action-RMS is -0.0001466717233041. Thus an unconditional utility interpretation is not supported. Native learning might selectively repair the full channel when arbitrary initial action and membership vectors interfere. Completing the native/action-RMS pair tests codebook learnability by action replacement, and compares this interaction across membership initializations. The alternative is that the small action advantage is representation/optimization contingent and remains absent at action-RMS initialization. The incumbent remains g3-r0065-fixed_angle_cycle_source_bit_negative (AUC0.6689612705559688) until admissible validation evidence supports a change.

nearest_work.difference: Archived v4 primary text lines75-85 describes target-conditioned local activation. Inherit its locally adapted scorer/readouts; test action-codebook learning and exact-membership replacement inside the existing compressed model. Neither exact DIN reproduction nor novelty is claimed.

Pinned benchmark forward lines123-170 embeds history and initializes task hubs from task masks. It motivates checking action/membership redundancy, but no hub or broadcast architecture is adopted. This is source inspection, not reproduction or evidence of local effectiveness.

Pinned benchmark forward lines123-153 adds item and action embeddings before unified interaction. No transduction block is adopted; the new pair isolates action-codebook gradient exposure in the inherited model. Original method equivalence is unverified.

Pinned lines112-145 classify every nn.Embedding parameter for the embedding optimizer, including membership_embedding. This excludes a guessed dense-versus-embedding optimizer explanation; native versus blocked exposure remains the intervention.

Pinned lines383-408 and535-577 construct task masks deterministically from action-token parts, preserve history masking and set target action zero. Masks being functions of actions does not establish the inverse; no vocabulary or global reconstruction is invented.

inherited_components: Whole strongest visible candidate architecture and custom context-surrogate backward; comparison lineage does not establish a mechanism.
Round89 standalone full/action-RMS source SHA2560d7ce2926267aec9c5cb215f9e5c48dc83eaf598a4c5250b111759f5cd3d9f11, including its executed but unselected conditional mean helper.
Exact four-mask 16x16 membership embedding, existing action codebook, all original input channels and host optimizer grouping.
All frozen protocol and host-owned construction, labels, scoring, resource accounting and closed holdout.
study.proposed_difference: Only action_codebook_gradient changes from blocked to native in the two action-RMS cells. The new full/blind pair changes only historical_action_mode while every module and initialization is identical. Reuse existing frozen action-RMS controls and all four zero-initialized cells. This completes the missing two cells of action representation x codebook gradient x membership initialization without redundant full training bridges. No loss, training recipe or host contract changes.
predictions: Define D(g,i)=AUC(full,g,i)-AUC(blind,g,i), I(i)=D(native,i)-D(blocked,i), J=I(action_rms)-I(zero). Known I(zero)=0.0001286872687999; D(blocked,action_rms)=-0.0001466717233041. Report all main effects and interactions with their exact source lineage.

The selective-learning hypothesis predicts positive I(action_rms) and restoration of positive D(native,action_rms). A descriptive effect of at least0.0002 AUC is predeclared as worth follow-up, not statistical significance or an equivalence bound.

At copied fixed parameter state, native and blocked versions of the SAME representation have identical forward predictions and buffers; their only intended difference is the action-codebook gradient. The full/blind pair has identical initial state tensors, but need not have identical predictions.

Both new models should allocate32192677 parameters with no new buffers and have full-unit cost near the observed446-468 seconds. Measure host train/inference costs rather than infer efficiency from fixed shapes.
falsifiers: If D(native,action_rms)<=0, selective learnability does not restore full-action superiority in this implementation. If I(action_rms)<=0, the selective-learning direction fails even if both arms improve.

A positive result confined to one initialization, one seed or one surrogate-gradient architecture cannot establish conditional information beyond membership, event alignment or a general feedback mechanism.

Invalid masking, target-action dependence, mismatched state/RNG initialization, altered non-action gradients at a copied state, missing gradients in the native codebook, or any protocol mismatch invalidate attribution regardless of AUC.

Full versus conditional means being exactly metric-equal does not prove input or checkpoint equality. No heterogeneous within-row membership strata or no nonzero action displacement makes alignment removal uninformative; unavailable diagnostics remain unknown.
alternative_explanations: One frozen training seed; same-seed bridges are reproducibility checks, not independent repetitions.
Changing codebook gradients changes gradient-active functional capacity and Adagrad exposure even though allocated parameters are equal.
Full and blind codebooks receive different gradient aggregation; action-blind codebook means provide only a shared offset.
Exact-mask membership is a function of historical actions; input action codes may add no information if this mapping is injective. That converse has not been measured.
The reused blind frozen initialized source predates an unused conditional-mean helper. Its absence is mathematically inert for outputs; host source/state/gradient parity must be checked before reuse.
Finite precision, initialization orientation, BatchNorm trajectories, one-pass optimization and the inherited surrogate VJP may explain metric differences.

validation_plan.local_completed: Ancestor and initial source hashes verified; AST/syntax, literal config, constructor defaults and source-boundary checks performed without importing torch. No training, installations or data access here.
host_preflight_required: Construct both new arms with identical feature_map and frozen host settings. Assert identical state_dict tensors, shapes, RNG-after-construction and parameter counts; check nn.Embedding optimizer membership. Treat original action-table trainability as unchanged requires_grad, with only edge detachment differing in blocked controls.

For each representation, clone a common parameter/buffer state and compare native versus blocked config: equal train/eval forward probabilities and running buffers, all four finite outputs, all four true-label losses, and equal non-action gradients at that copied state. Require native action gradients on a nondegenerate batch and blocked gradients absent/zero. Do not finite-difference the inherited surrogate VJP as if it were an ordinary derivative.

Check blind predictions and gradients remain invariant under perturbation of historical action IDs while keeping valid masks, task memberships, item/context values and copied buffers fixed. Unknown target action must never affect either arm. Test empty, partial and full histories and perturb masked padding. These are synthetic model tests only, not altered scientific training inputs.

Old blind frozen initialized code has an unused mean helper difference. Verify frozen blind output/state/gradient parity before using its receipt as a factorial control. If parity cannot be established, label the cross-round comparison nonmatched and do not silently substitute it.

Optional membership_diagnostics and conditional_action_diagnostics require an explicit budgeted host call on authorized training batches; aggregate valid rows/events, 16-by-action contingency, heterogeneous row-strata and displaced channels. No diagnostics were returned in supplied receipts, so reconstruction, heterogeneity and alignment remain unverified. Do not introduce a training callback or claim this proposal automatically collects these data.
validation_plan.analysis: Full-population validation click AUC selects. Report all four AUC and unweighted logloss, auxiliary mean AUC, allocated and gradient-active parameters, train/wall/GPU seconds, examples, peak memory, inference throughput and batch p50/p95 with existing measurement definitions. Report full/blind deltas, I and J, and predeclared empty/1-16/17-64/>64 history slices including positive/negative counts. Other slices require actually available host diagnostics; label absent metrics unavailable. Paired user-cluster bootstrap only if authorized prediction/user identities are supplied by the host; do not infer significance from point estimates or repeated same-seed receipts.
validation_plan.selection_and_assessment: Keep the untouched incumbent as the best measured visible model until validation supports selection. This proposal is not a held-out request. Before any later withheld assessment freeze exact source/config/checkpoint hashes, the incumbent and selected candidate, closest full/blind controls, relevant initialization and gradient ablations, permitted paired seeds and commands; withheld outcomes go only to the closed archive.

No executable host training command is exposed in this coding phase; do not invent one.
